translations.web: They hunt our steps, so that we can’t go in our streets. Our end is near. Our days are fulfilled, for our end has come.
translations.bsb: They stalked our every step, so that we could not walk in our streets. Our end drew near, our time ran out, for our end had come!
translations.kjv: They hunt our steps, that we cannot go in our streets: our end is near, our days are fulfilled; for our end is come.
